title: $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,E)$ is a left adjoint for proper $p$
statement:
Let $E$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, let $\Lambda=\underline E$
([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]), and let $p\colon Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of the setting. Then
the derived pushforward $Rp_*\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Z,\underline E)\to D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Y,\underline E)$
of [def-sfb-dc-lower-star] has a right adjoint $Rp^!$.

external.place: This is the existence of the exceptional inverse image for $\ell$-adic sheaves (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).
This is the existence of the exceptional inverse image for $\ell$-adic sheaves (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).
On each torsion level $\cO_E/\varpi^n$, in which $p$ is invertible, the étale $Rp_*=Rp_!$ has a right adjoint $Rp^!$ (SGA 4, XVIII).
It preserves bounded constructible complexes by Deligne's finiteness theorem (SGA 4½, *Th. finitude*), and it is compatible with reduction modulo $\varpi^n$.

proof.text:
This is the existence of the exceptional inverse image for $\ell$-adic sheaves
(Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8). On each torsion level $\cO_E/\varpi^n$, in which $p$ is invertible, the
étale $Rp_*=Rp_!$ has a right adjoint $Rp^!$ (SGA 4, XVIII). It preserves bounded
constructible complexes by Deligne's finiteness theorem (SGA 4½, *Th. finitude*), and it is
compatible with reduction modulo $\varpi^n$. Passing to the derived limit over $n$ gives a right
adjoint of $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,\underline{\cO}_E)$. Inverting $\ell$ gives one on
$D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,\underline E)$.
